headline: T Swift's Baddies Drop a 196-Burger While Little Peckers Get Cooked Alive
subhead: Week 10 served up the most lopsided beatdown of the year, a Jonathan Taylor explosion, and a Stroud Boys QB room that suddenly looks like a Brissett hoarding operation.
matchOfTheWeek: T Swift's Baddies vs Little Peckers wasn't a matchup, it was a hate crime — 196.14 to 84.22, a 111.92-point demolition. Gibbs went for 38.2, Stafford added 26.9, and meanwhile Unc and the Peckers couldn't crack 85 combined. Tnicolle didn't just win, she made @7BigPapi7 question why he logs in.
powerRankingsShakeup: The Good Ladds just dropped 182.98 thanks to a Jonathan Taylor 49-burger and are screaming up the board, while Rub My Chubb and Little Peckers are racing each other to the basement in a clown car.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the carnage. The Good Ladds hung 182.98 on QAmon because Jonathan Taylor decided Week 10 was his personal highlight reel — 49.60 points, the kind of number that makes @KyleDech close the app and go for a walk. Tiny-Handed Vampire and the rest of QAmon's roster put up a respectable 124, which still loses by 58. To make it worse, Dillon Gabriel scored 20.08 on QAmon's bench. Yes, that Dillon Gabriel. Start your guys, Kyle.

Browning Out feasted on Rub My Chubb 159-109, with Achane going for 40.5 — but the real story is BigD leaving 34.20 points on the pine. Jalen Nailor put up 23.40 in street clothes on your bench while you trotted out lineup filler. Kittle's 27.9 was wasted on a loss. Brutal.

McBridesStrangeWhiteHock squeaked past Christian McCalfinjury by 6.60, entirely because the team's namesake Trey McBride dropped 32.2 like he was contractually obligated. @mattwunder, meanwhile, got a 26.28 from Jaxson Dart AND left Dalton Schultz's 21.80 rotting on the bench. You started the wrong tight end in the closest game of the week. That's a paddlin'.

Egbukkake handled Stroud Boys 148-126 despite Money Mill$ going full god-mode at 28.68 and The Prodigal Son adding 28. @bjewett13 spent the week trading Brissetts around the league like Pokémon cards — sent him to the Ladds, then somehow got him back from McBride's? The Stroud Boys QB room is now just Davis Mills and vibes after shipping him to Nut Olave.

Nut Olave Your Face beat OnlyFants 139-117 on the back of Nail Polish Enthusiast's 25.1, while Tez Johnson dropped 20.2 on the bench and Jerry Jeudy wasted 19.8 for ChrisCubby. Two managers, same disease: can't read a matchup page.

weeklyAwards.title: Nuclear Strike of the Week
weeklyAwards.blurb: 196.14 points and 98.9% efficiency — Tnicolle didn't beat Little Peckers, she filed a war crimes report on him.

weeklyAwards.title: Bench Warmer Hall of Shame
weeklyAwards.blurb: 34.20 points left rotting on the pine in a 50-point loss — Jalen Nailor put up 23.4 in a hoodie while you started a corpse.

weeklyAwards.title: Workhorse Award
weeklyAwards.blurb: Jonathan Taylor's 49.60-point eruption made Mig56 look like a genius — for one week, ignore the 27 Jaydens on the roster.

weeklyAwards.title: QB Hoarder Anonymous
weeklyAwards.blurb: Traded Brissett, re-acquired Brissett, shipped Money Mill$ — bjewett13 is running a quarterback laundromat and still lost.
